description:
Configure the Postfix mail server to route all outgoing emails through an external authenticated SMTP relay. 

Details:
- Relay Host: smtp.secure-relay.com
- Port: 587
- Authentication: Enabled (SASL)
- Username: relay_transport
- Password: SecureRoute99!

Navigate to Webmin > Servers > Postfix Mail Server. You need to configure the 'SMTP Relay Host' (or General Options) and 'SMTP Authentication' settings. Ensure that SASL authentication is enabled and the credentials are correctly mapped for the relay host.
